#--------------------------------------------------
echo "Port Configuration"
#--------------------------------------------------
    port nt-a:xfp:1
        description "LAB optical port"
        ethernet
            lldp
                dest-mac nearest-bridge
                    admin-status tx-rx
                    tx-tlvs port-desc sys-name sys-desc sys-cap
                exit
            exit
        exit
        no shutdown
    exit
    port nt-a:xfp:2
        shutdown
        ethernet
            speed 1000
        exit
    exit
    port nt-a:eth:1
        ethernet
        exit
        no shutdown
    exit
    port lt:1/1/7
        ethernet
        exit
        no shutdown
    exit
    port nt:vp:1
        no shutdown
    exit
#--------------------------------------------------
echo "LAG Configuration"
#--------------------------------------------------
    lag 7
        description "LAB aggregation"
        port nt-a:xfp:1
        port nt-a:xfp:2
        lacp active administrative-key 32768
        no shutdown
    exit
    lag 8
        shutdown
    exit
#--------------------------------------------------
echo "Service Configuration"
#--------------------------------------------------
    service
        customer 10 create
            description "LAB customer"
        exit
        ies 20 customer 10 create
            interface "LAB management" create
                address 192.0.2.5/24
                sap nt:vp:1:190 create
                exit
            exit
            no shutdown
        exit
        vpls 200 customer 10 v-vpls vlan 200 create
            description "LAB service"
            stp
                shutdown
            exit
            sap nt-a:eth:1:200 create
                no shutdown
            exit
            sap nt-a:xfp:1:200 create
                no shutdown
            exit
            sap lt:1/1/7:200 create
                no shutdown
            exit
            sap lag-7:200 create
                no shutdown
            exit
            no shutdown
        exit
    exit
----------------------------------------------
